title: Expedition 69Axiom Mission 2 International Space Station Undocking - May 30, 2023
description: Axiom Mission-2, the second private astronaut mission to the International Space Station, undocked from the orbiting laboratory with its crew of Peggy Whitson, John Shoffner, Ali Alqarni, and Rayyanah Barnawi on May 30. Prior to undocking, the crew entered their Dragon spacecraft Freedom for the trip back to Earth and a splashdown off the coast of Florida.    Join NASA as we go forward to the Moon and on to Mars -- discover the latest on Earth, the Solar System and beyond with a weekly update in your inbox.  Subscribe at: www.nasa.gov/subscribe
keywords: Axiom Mission 2, SpaceX, Peggy Whitson, John Shoffner, Ali Alqarni, Rayyanah Barnawi
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
